summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K press release announcing a maiden mineral resource estimate (MRE) for its 100%-owned Motapa property in Zimbabwe, prepared per NI 43-101. The MRE reports 379,000 ounces gold measured and indicated (7.8 Mt @ 1.51 g/t) plus 131,000 ounces inferred (2.7 Mt @ 1.48 g/t) at a 0.5 g/t cut-off. The company noted $7.084 million exploration spend plus $8.25 million acquisition cost, totaling $40.45 per measured and indicated ounce. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation; no transaction, board action, or strategic event is presented. Watch for the NI 43-101 technical report filing on SEDAR+ within 45 days.
